verdict.rationale: Browserbase docs describe creating, controlling, and observing browser sessions programmatically, with 'live view' and 'session replay' explicitly listed as observability features, which supports interactive manual browsing of a remote sandbox (browserbase-docs-1, browserbase-docs-26). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the live view supports true manual interactive control (not just observation), and no dedicated docs page detailing manual session UX beyond the marketing bullet.
